title: unlink commit message contains literal <target> placeholder
description: operations.rs remove_relationship formats its jj commit message as 'Remove relationship: {source} {relation} <target>' - the literal placeholder instead of the target title. Repro: link A required_for B, unlink, run jj log - the newest commit reads 'Remove relationship: A required_for <target>'. Acceptance: commit message names the target issue (title, or short id if the target no longer loads). Test: jj_integration t11.
